title: MRCD: multimodal contextual recognition engine for speech disfluencies in Spanish (with the ASR-survival benchmark)
description: Open-source engine for detecting filler words, prolongations and repetitions in Spanish speech, plus a reusable benchmark (benchmarks/asr_survival) that measures how much human-annotated disfluency evidence survives in ASR transcripts of a 1,025-turn DIHANA frame. The benchmark ships identifiers, labels, prompts, code and aggregate results only; no corpus text and no audio. DIHANA (CC BY 4.0) must be obtained and cited separately.
